name: magic-link-sign-in
title: Magic link sign-in
description: Passwordless sign-in: one email field, then an in-place check-your-inbox state with a timed resend and a way back to the form.
docs: onRequestLink({ email, remember }) asks your server to email the link. Resolve whether or not the address has an account, so the card never shows which addresses are registered (the confirmation says If the address has an account, a link is on its way); reject only when the request itself failed, and the card keeps the typed address and shows one retry message. A malformed address is caught when the field is left, with the message tied to the field. On success the card swaps in place to Check your inbox: it names the address, says the link works once for expiresInMinutes (default 15), says where to look, and offers Resend link, Use a different email and, with onUsePassword, Sign in with a password. The resend button counts down resendAfter seconds (default 30) in tabular figures, its name stays Resend link while it waits, and the status region speaks only when the wait starts and when it ends; the wait is worked out from timestamps, so it is right after the tab sleeps. Focus moves to the confirmation heading and back to the field. signedIn flips the card to You are signed in with a Continue button (onSignedIn) for apps that notice the link was opened in another tab. defaultEmail and defaultSent start on the confirmation, titleAs sets the heading element, footer sits under the card, labels translates every word.
